Grace (Docs): Quick note: found stale snippets in function/tool-calling docs using the `tool_output` envelope. Opening a tiny PR to standardize on `output` and add a one-line legacy shim. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8200

Ravi (SDK): I will update TS snippets (callTool -> invoke) and add a legacy alias in the examples.

Marta (Eng): I'll update JSON schema examples to use `output` and add `additionalProperties: false`. Also include the migration snippet: `result = resp.get('output') or resp.get('tool_output')`.

docs-bot: PR #8200 created by @Grace — link-checker flagged 1 dead internal link.

Grace (Docs): I'll patch the link and aim to merge after two reviews. Thanks!
